commits.message: v1.2.0 tier 1: six drain-engine swaps under reading B — Vein Ripper, Bastion of Remembrance, Twilight Prophet, Species Specialist, Toxic Deluge, Malakir Bloodwitch for Conqueror, Cordial, Legion Lieutenant, Blade, Stromkirk Captain, Bloodflow. Lords 7 -> 4, free outlets 6 -> 5, the eminence leg -2 (Bastion, Deluge, Specialist are not Vampires).

staged.why: Reading B: Conqueror is the one card in both two-card infinites (stacks 004/006 with Vito / Sanguine Bond); cutting him takes the floor from 4 to 3. Vein Ripper is a 6/5 flying Vampire whose ward is a sacrifice and whose death trigger is a 2-point drain — candidate_scan drain+threat row (death_drain), prescription add #3, recon finding 2 (the strongest card-specific write-ups), EDHREC synergy +0.15 on the base page. Predicted: drain_dealt up, biggest_hit up, evasive share up. Cites strategy:aristocrats.drain-scope.

Cordial is a +1/+1-counters lord whose counters die with the board in the wipes log 006 describes (prescription cut #1). Bastion is a death drain on an ENCHANTMENT — each opponent loses 1 and you gain 1 per creature death, so an opponent's wipe pays instead of costing (recon finding 3; candidate_scan drain row death_drain=True; prescription add #1, natural cut Cordial). Predicted: drain_dealt up. Cites strategy:aristocrats.wipe-insurance.

Legion Lieutenant is a vanilla static lord (prescription cut #4). Twilight Prophet is a 2/4 flying Vampire that, with the city's blessing, puts the top card into hand every upkeep and drains each opponent for its mana value — the one card the sources name for both halves of the pilot's complaint (recon finding 1, 245/484 lifedrain lists; EDHREC synergy +0.39, 23,648 decks; prescription add #4; candidate_scan drain+gain+draw rows). Predicted: drain_dealt up, extra_draw_per_turn up, empty_hand_turns down. Cites strategy:card-advantage.plan-draw.

Blade is the purest wait-for-a-death counter engine in the list (prescription cut #3). Species Specialist, naming Vampire, draws a card whenever a Vampire you control dies — INCLUDING the eminence tokens, which Midnight Reaper and Grim Haruspex ('nontoken') cannot see (recon finding 6; candidate_scan draw row trigger=death, nontoken=False). The complaint is 1-2 cards in hand from turn 5; the baseline draws 1.46 extra a turn and still empties, so draw that lands on the deaths the outlets cause is the shape wanted. Predicted: extra_draw_per_turn up, empty_hand_turns down. Cites strategy:aristocrats.wipe-insurance, strategy:card-advantage.plan-draw.

Stromkirk is a static lord in the deck's shortest colour (prescription cut #2, 'easy'). The deck carries zero sweepers (audit: sweepers 0 UNDER); Toxic Deluge is the three-mana one whose life cost a drain deck refunds, and with Bastion, Blood Artist, Cruel Celebrant and Species Specialist out it is deaths on our terms — every creature that dies drains and draws (prescription add #2; candidate_scan sweeper row; recon finding 9). RemoveDeck:All was unflagged on 2026-09-30 so the Forge AI can cast it. Predicted: drain_dealt up, combat damage down. Cites strategy:deckbuilding.typal-density.lord-exposure.

Bloodflow is a three-mana 1/1 whose only text is a sacrifice outlet, the weakest of six (prescription cut #8, 'easy'; its natural cut for this add); five outlets remain. Malakir Bloodwitch is a 4/4 flying Vampire with protection from white whose ETB drains each opponent for the number of Vampires you control and gains that much — the most-run drain Vampire the deck lacks (recon finding 0, 261/484 lifedrain lists; EDHREC synergy +0.46, 26,911 decks; prescription add #5; candidate_scan drain+gain+threat rows). The sixth swap, decided 2026-09-30 ('five or six, I just want the absolute best deck'). Predicted: drain_dealt up, biggest_hit up, evasive share up. Cites strategy:life-as-resource.lifegain-engine.
